reviewer.procedure: Inspect pinned negative report and source-reproduction workflow; distinguish modeled connectivity from physical/legal access; answer every access question without inferring from proximity.

sources.provenance: Pinned Arizona OSM report, independently reproducible by .github/workflows/tucson-unreachable-negative.yml. Same-source topology evidence, not independent access evidence.

physical_connection.reason: The 5691.8 m geometric gap is not a surveyed or documented drivable path. The selected road node belongs to a three-node modeled component; this does not establish real-world inaccessibility.

legal_motor_access.reason: OSM residential/track and TIGER tags do not establish a public right of motor access; no independent access record retained.

same_grade.reason: No independent survey, imagery interpretation or agency record demonstrates the proposed origin-to-road connection at the correct grade.

direction_and_turns.reason: The static model does not resolve all turn restrictions; no reviewed connector geometry or directed entry has been selected.

connector_cost.reason: No physical connector path selected; straight-line gap cannot supply a validated travel distance or time.

limitations: Reject only this candidate for current modeled routing to the existing probes, not Tucson eligibility or real-world accessibility.
No urban anchor selected. Preserve Census regression; a future urban anchor is a different versioned candidate.
AI review is not a separate release approver. No approval ledger mutation or geographic coverage claim.
